notes: PRINTER and SETUP: tap or press a setting to light it, turn the knob to change it either way, tap or press again to keep it (rows that do something still do it at once)
Counters: THE STRIP -- the + on a counter's page puts it on the strip; PRINT STRIP on the list prints them stacked as one piece with a cut line between
Printer: SWITCH on the PRINTER page goes between the printers you have used without a scan -- each keeps its own settings
Printer: PULL BACK and FEED AFTER for the PD01 family's blank paper; the PD01 and its family print over Bluetooth
Game Boy: .gbc games in colour, sound, long file names; Music: the player comes back after an update check
